basic_info.description: Bright mid-century 3bd/2ba Noe Valley home with Eastern views, gorgeous garden, flexible  floor plan, expansion potential and solar panels. The main level features an open, sun-filled living room / dining room with fireplace and large windows framing the view, an updated kitchen, and two bedrooms and one bath. The lower level is reserved for the master suite (with kitchenette, which could be great for in-law or income potential) with sliding doors to East facing deck and access to deep backyard and lush garden. Nestled between Noe Valley and Glen Park - walking distance to Billy Goat Hill and Walter Haas Playground, 3.5 blocks to Church Street with Muni Lines.
